policy_name: OpenAPI 3.0 to JSON Schema Draft-07 Conversion and Dialect Governance Policy
governing_benchmark: Contract Fragility Schema Complexity Benchmark (Stage B)
epistemic_mandate: Copying OpenAPI 3.0 modifiers verbatim into Draft-07 without dialect transformation alters validation semantics. All dialect transformations must be explicitly categorized, executed deterministically, and never classified as verbatim syntactic preservation.

A_SAFE_SYNTACTIC_PRESERVATION.description: Keywords with identical syntax and identical validation semantics in both OpenAPI 3.0 and JSON Schema Draft-07.
A_SAFE_SYNTACTIC_PRESERVATION.governance_rule: Preserved verbatim only when the keyword is not modified by dialect-sensitive sibling keywords.

B_EXPLICIT_SEMANTIC_PRESERVING_CONVERSIO.description: OpenAPI 3.0 constructs that require syntactic conversion to retain equivalent validation semantics under JSON Schema Draft-07.

nullable_true.constraint_retention_rule: All other schema constraints (e.g., minimum, maximum, minLength, pattern) are retained verbatim. If an enum is defined, null is only valid if explicitly included in the enum array; nullability does not relax enum membership constraints.
nullable_true.post_conversion_cleanup: The OpenAPI-only 'nullable' keyword must be removed from the generated Draft-07 schema contract.
nullable_true.rationale: JSON Schema Draft-07 ignores 'nullable: true'. Translating to a multi-type array [T, 'null'] faithfully preserves the source specification allowance for null values.

nullable_false.constraint_retention_rule: Retain primitive type <T>. Draft-07 primitive types exclude null by default.
nullable_false.post_conversion_cleanup: Remove redundant 'nullable: false' keyword from Draft-07 contract.
nullable_false.rationale: Draft-07 primitive types are non-nullable by definition; removing nullable: false is a lossless normalization.

exclusiveMinimum_boolean.constraint_retention_rule: Remove 'minimum' and assign numeric bound to 'exclusiveMinimum'.
exclusiveMinimum_boolean.post_conversion_cleanup: Remove boolean exclusiveMinimum and minimum keywords.
exclusiveMinimum_boolean.rationale: Draft-07 requires numeric bounds for exclusiveMinimum; boolean values cause validator SchemaError.

exclusiveMaximum_boolean.constraint_retention_rule: Remove 'maximum' and assign numeric bound to 'exclusiveMaximum'.
exclusiveMaximum_boolean.post_conversion_cleanup: Remove boolean exclusiveMaximum and maximum keywords.
exclusiveMaximum_boolean.rationale: Draft-07 requires numeric bounds for exclusiveMaximum; boolean values cause validator SchemaError.

example_singular.target_syntax: examples: [<V>] or retained as informative extension
example_singular.constraint_retention_rule: Singular example is non-validating in both dialects.
example_singular.post_conversion_cleanup: Retain singular example as extension metadata or normalize to examples array.
example_singular.rationale: Example values do not affect Draft-07 validation assertion outcomes.

C_EXPLICIT_REPRESENTATION_CHANGING_NORMA.description: Architectural normalizations required to adapt heterogeneous HTTP operations to standardized function tool call interfaces.

wrapper_closed_object_policy.description: Synthesized root and transport surface wrappers (path, query, header, body) enforce additionalProperties: false for strict tool-argument evaluation.
wrapper_closed_object_policy.acknowledgment: Deliberate non-lossless normalization; requires explicit human validation sign-off.

transport_serialization_metadata.description: OpenAPI form serialization metadata (style, explode, allowReserved) quarantined in x-openapi-encoding or x-benchmark-metadata.
transport_serialization_metadata.acknowledgment: Standard Draft-07 validators ignore x- properties; preserves Tier 2 in-process serialization fidelity.

D_UNSUPPORTED_REJECTED_CONSTRUCTS.description: Dialect features that cannot be mapped into JSON Schema Draft-07 without semantic ambiguity; extractor must fail closed.

readOnly_in_request_surface.rationale: Function tool call arguments represent write request payloads. Properties marked readOnly in request bodies violate HTTP request semantics (RFC 7231 / OpenAPI 3.0 section 4.7.24).

discriminator.rationale: OpenAPI discriminator mapping is an object-polymorphism mechanism unsupported in monomorphic tool extraction.

polymorphic_union.rationale: Top-level or nested oneOf/anyOf unions require dedicated union protocol under Protocol Amendment 003.

unknown_oas_keyword.rationale: Unregistered or vendor-specific schema keywords fail closed to prevent silent semantic corruption.
